newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says no plan to exclude Yamaichi from auctions.
newsitem.headline: MOF says no plan to exclude Yamaichi from auctions.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) has no plans at the moment to take any punitive measures against Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd regarding underwriting or participation in auctions of Japanese government bonds (JGBs), a MOF official said on Wednesday.

The official said he was aware that investigators from the Tokyo prosecutors office and the securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC), had begun investigating Yamaichi on Wednesday, but added that he did not know the results of the investigation and that the ministry would not take any action while the SESC investigation was still going on.
"At the moment, while the SESC investigation is still being carried out, we will not take any measures," he said.
But the official added that the ministry would take appropriate measures once the results of the investigation became known.
